must_show: a wide hull flaring out from the waterline to the deck edge, with a hard knuckle along the forward third (x 25 .. 76), beam 20.1 m at the deck edge amidships
a raked stem, about 10 m of rake from the waterline to the stem head at x 76.95; the SQS-53 dome under the forefoot
the flight deck a deck lower than the main deck (z 4.25 against 6.45), stepped down abaft x -51.0, with the team ring on it and no hangar
one raked, chamfered superstructure block, every wall leaning in and every corner cut: the 01 level from x -28.8, the SPY block x 10.6 .. 29.4 to the pilot house roof z 17.4

four SPY-1D octagons, all on the forward block's four chamfered corners, centres at z 14.25 (Flight I: the after pair at the same height as the forward pair), haze grey a shade over the house (#7b8288) in a darker frame ring (#5f666c), not radome white
the raked plated tripod mast from x 19.2 at its foot to x 12.7 at z 37.3, two big yards, painted black from the lower yard up (Flight I)
two trapezoid stacks, every face leaning in, open sooted tops with louvre bars: the forward one at x 5.85 (top z 20.2), the after one at x -10.6 (top z 20.05)
the 29-cell Mk 41 field on the forecastle at x 39.5 (4.5 x 6.6 m, four modules) and the 61-cell field on the main deck at x -38.9 (9.0 x 6.6 m, eight modules), each with its strikedown crane
the 5-inch/54 Mk 45 Mod 1 in its rounded house on the forecastle at x 48.0 (node turret)
two Phalanx white domes: forward on the 02-level ledge in front of the SPY block at x 30.6, aft at the after end of the after house at x -26.6 in its railed tub
the two Harpoon quads crossing the deck abaft the after house at x -32.6 (starboard) and -30.4 (port)
two RHIBs in davits in the starboard recess of the after house's 01 level (x -28 .. -12), life-raft cradles to port
lifelines along every exposed deck edge, the solid bulwark round the stem head (x 68.5 .. 76.6), bitts at x 58, 36 and -20 each side, the jackstaff at x 76.2
